posts.post: Everyone is obsessed with fast fashion hauls but the quality is literally paper thin. My pieces are made with intention only after you order them. Why pay for corporate waste when you can actually have something that lasts? Thoughts?
Low rise jeans aren't the problem. You just don't know how to balance the silhouette with a proper top. It is about proportions, not trends. Change my mind.
If your clothes don't feel like a protective layer against the world, you are wearing the wrong things. Stop dressing for the algorithm and start dressing for your own ego. Am I being too much?
